newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says will need to study Boeing deal.
newsitem.headline: EU says will need to study Boeing deal.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Wednesday that at a first glance it appeared that a merger between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas Corp would have to be notified to the European Union competition authorities.
"It seems to use that it may raise raise questions regarding a dominant position (in the EU)," Van Miert said.
The Commission has the right to vet mergers between companies that do a significant amount of business in the European Union.
The two U.S. aerospace companies announced on Sunday a $13.3 billion stock-for-stock merger.
Van Miert said the dossier could be "complex and problematic".
